name: Tiled Background
description: Tile an image over an area. Tiled Backgrounds are faster than tiling Sprites.

conditions.description: True if tile randomization is currently enabled.
Triggered after 'Load image from URL' when the image has finished loading.

conditions.display-text: On image URL failed to load
conditions.description: Triggered after 'Load image from URL' if the image fails to load.

actions.description: Set the background blend mode for this object.

blend-mode.name: Blend mode
blend-mode.desc: Choose the new blend mode for this object.

actions.description: Set the X offset of the image within the object.

offset-x.name: X offset
offset-x.desc: The X offset of the image within the object, in pixels.

actions.description: Set the Y offset of the image within the object.

offset-y.name: Y offset
offset-y.desc: The Y offset of the image within the object, in pixels.

actions.description: Set the X scale of the image within the object.

scale-x.name: X scale
scale-x.desc: The X scale of the image within the object, as a percentage.

actions.description: Set the Y scale of the image within the object.

scale-y.name: Y scale
scale-y.desc: The Y scale of the image within the object, as a percentage.

actions.description: Set the angle of the image within the object.

angle.name: Angle
angle.desc: The angle of the image within the object, in degrees.

actions.description: Set whether tile randomization is enabled.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether to enable or disable tile randomization.

actions.description: Set the amount of horizontal and vertical randomness for tile randomization.

x-random.name: X random
x-random.desc: Amount of horizontal randomness, from 0 to 100.

y-random.name: Y random
y-random.desc: Amount of vertical randomness, from 0 to 100.

actions.description: Set the amount of angle randomness for tile randomization.

angle-random.name: Angle random
angle-random.desc: Amount of angle randomness, from 0 to 100.

actions.description: Set the percentage of the tile that fades to adjacent tile.

blend-margin-x.name: Blend margin X
blend-margin-x.desc: Percentage of tile width that fades to adjacent tile, 0-100.

blend-margin-y.name: Blend margin Y
blend-margin-y.desc: Percentage of tile height that fades to adjacent tile, 0-100.

actions.description: Load an image from a web address or data URI.

uri.name: URI
uri.desc: Enter the URL on the web, or data URI, of an image to load.

cross-origin.name: Cross-origin
cross-origin.desc: The cross-origin (CORS) mode to use for the request.

edit-image.name: Image
edit-image.desc: Click to edit the object's image.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose whether the object is visible when the layout starts.

origin.name: Origin
origin.desc: Choose the location of the origin in the object.

wrap-horizontal.name: Wrap horizontal
wrap-horizontal.desc: How the image wraps horizontally. Note: this applies to all instances of this object type.

wrap-vertical.name: Wrap vertical
wrap-vertical.desc: How the image wraps vertically. Note: this applies to all instances of this object type.

image-transform.name: Image transform
image-transform.desc: Adjust how the tiled image is displayed within the object.

image-offset-x.name: Image offset X
image-offset-x.desc: The X offset of the image within the object, in pixels.

image-offset-y.name: Image offset Y
image-offset-y.desc: The Y offset of the image within the object, in pixels.

image-scale-x.desc: The X scale of the image within the object.

image-scale-y.name: Image scale Y
image-scale-y.desc: The Y scale of the image within the object.

image-angle.name: Image angle
image-angle.desc: The angle of the image within the object, in degrees.

tile-randomization.name: Tile randomization
tile-randomization.desc: Break up repetitive patterns by applying a random offset and orientation for each tile and blending the edges.

enable-tile-randomization.name: Enable tile randomization
enable-tile-randomization.desc: Whether to enable random offsets and orientation for tiles to break up repetitive patterns.

blend-margin-x.name: Blend margin X
blend-margin-x.desc: Percentage of tile width that fades to adjacent tile.

blend-margin-y.name: Blend margin Y
blend-margin-y.desc: Percentage of tile height that fades to adjacent tile.
